observedInstead: After reload the page renders the welcome screen with no prior messages, and the drawer stays on "Loading threads…" with zero rows for the whole 40s capture window.
During the post flow the agent logs no `GET /threads` (list) request at all, while `POST /threads` (create) succeeds elsewhere in the same session - the drawer never asks for the list.
inferredFromSource: CopilotThreadsDrawer.tsx:255/262/271/296 gates useThreads({ enabled: licensed }); licensed is false unless the runtime reports status "valid"/"expiring", and licensePending (status === null) is exactly the branch that shows the loading state rather than the locked view - so with no license configured the query is disabled AND the spinner never resolves.

packages/react-core/src/v2 contains no localStorage/sessionStorage/cookie use (only v1-deprecated dev-console does), and page.tsx mounts CopilotChatConfigurationProvider with no threadId prop, so the active thread is in-memory and a reload mints a new one.
